examples.label: Confirmation banner after a profile is saved
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-flash" site="Global" id="flash-profile-saved" variant="default" kind={:success} title="Profile updated" icon="hero-check-circle">
  Your new display name and photo are now visible everywhere on the site.
</.component>

examples.label: Payment failure alert with the next step
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-flash" site="Global" id="flash-payment-failed" variant="default" kind={:danger} title="Payment failed" icon="hero-x-circle">
  We could not charge the card ending in 4242. Update your billing details to keep your plan active.
</.component>

examples.label: Bordered maintenance notice, narrower and one size down
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-flash" site="Global" id="flash-maintenance" variant="bordered" kind={:info} title="Scheduled maintenance" icon="hero-information-circle" width="medium" size="small">
  The dashboard will be read-only on Friday from 22:00 to 23:30 UTC while we upgrade the database.
</.component>

examples.label: Draft-recovered note sized to its own content
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-flash" site="Global" id="flash-draft-recovered" kind={:natural} title="Draft recovered" icon="hero-document-arrow-up" width="fit">
  We restored the version you were writing before the tab closed, saved 4 minutes ago.
</.component>
